newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken buys stake in Norwegian company.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken buys stake in Norwegian company.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken said on Monday its subsidiary FinansSkandic bought a 50 percent stake in Norwegian car financing company Moller Bilfinans.

S-E-Banken said in a statement said the Moller group was privately owned and had a 20 percent market share of new car sales in Norway. The Moller group imports Volkswagen, Audi, Seat, Skoda and Chrysler, S-E-Banken said.

"The choice of S-E-Banken and FinansSkandic as partners was based on keen joint interest and trust that one of the Nordic region's largest and most well reknowned banks will have much to offer," S-E-Banken economic director Pal Syversen said in the statement.
FinansSkandic has decided to gradually build new, complete car financing operations in Norway and Sweden and the cooperation with the Moller group is part of this process, the company said.
